courses.title: Start Here · German Basics
courses.description: Letters and sounds, greetings, introducing yourself, numbers, time, days, months, weather and colours — everything for your first days with German.

modules.title: Buchstaben & Laute · Letters and Sounds
modules.description: Read any German word: alphabet, special sounds, syllables and stress.

modules.title: Hallo! · Hello and Goodbye
modules.description: Greet people, say goodbye politely and introduce yourself.

modules.title: Zahlen & Zeit · Numbers and Time
modules.description: Count, pay, give your phone number, say dates and tell the time.

modules.title: Kalender & Farben · Calendar and Colours
modules.description: Days, months, seasons, weather and colours.

courses.title: A1 Grammatik · Grammar Step by Step
courses.description: All A1 grammar in small steps: nouns and articles, verbs, questions, word order, modal and separable verbs, cases, prepositions and the past tense.

modules.title: Nomen & Artikel · Nouns and Articles
modules.description: der, die, das, ein, kein, plurals and how to say no.

modules.title: Verben im Präsens · Verbs in the Present
modules.description: Pronouns, verb endings, sein and haben, irregular verbs.

modules.title: Sätze & Fragen · Sentences and Questions
modules.description: W-questions, yes/no questions, word order and the imperative.

modules.title: Modalverben & Trennbare Verben · Modal and Separable Verbs
modules.description: können, müssen, wollen, dürfen, sollen, möchten and verbs that split.

modules.title: Die Fälle · Cases
modules.description: Nominativ, Akkusativ, Dativ and possessive articles.

modules.title: Präpositionen · Prepositions
modules.description: Time, accusative, dative and two-way prepositions.

modules.title: Vergangenheit · Talking About the Past
modules.description: Perfekt with haben and sein, war and hatte.

courses.title: Alltag auf Deutsch · Everyday German
courses.description: Real situations from life in Germany: family, your flat, food and shopping, your day, the town, the doctor, work, clothes and forms.

modules.title: Menschen & Familie · People and Family
modules.description: Talk about your family, where you come from and what people are like.

modules.title: Wohnen · Home
modules.description: Rooms, furniture and finding a flat.

modules.title: Essen & Einkaufen · Food and Shopping
modules.description: Food and drinks, the supermarket, cafés and restaurants.

modules.title: Alltag & Freizeit · Daily Life and Free Time
modules.description: Your daily routine, hobbies and making plans with friends.

modules.title: Stadt & Verkehr · Town and Transport
modules.description: Places in town, asking the way, buses, trains and tickets.

modules.title: Gesundheit · Health
modules.description: The body, visiting the doctor and making appointments by phone.

modules.title: Arbeit & Kleidung · Work and Clothes
modules.description: Jobs, buying clothes and filling in forms.

courses.title: Geschichten · Rafi in Köln
courses.description: Twelve short stories in easy German: follow Rafi from Bangladesh through his first year in Cologne — and learn real everyday German along the way.

modules.title: Ankommen · Arriving
modules.description: The flight, the first room in a shared flat and registering at the Bürgeramt.

modules.title: Neue Leute · New People
modules.description: The German course, the neighbour and a dinner with friends.

modules.title: Alltag · Everyday Life
modules.description: Bottle deposit, being ill and a train that leaves without Rafi.

modules.title: Neue Ziele · New Goals
modules.description: An email home, a job interview and one year in Cologne.
